title: Total/classical cohomology comparison on any supplied injective resolution
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with derived categories, with enough injectives and K-injective resolutions in C, and let F:C→D be additive [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility]. For M∈C, an injective resolution I of M, and n≥0, the canonical homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso has hom equal to Hⁿ(RF(singleFunctorIsoCompQ.hom;Q(I.ι′));rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso(I).hom), followed by homologyFunctorFactors.hom and I.isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex(F,n).inv. The K-injective structure is that of the bounded-below injective complex I.cochainComplex. No exactness assumption on F is made.

source.place: Tags 015E and 070K; the injective-resolution construction of derived functors and the total/plus compatibility

proof.text: For the chosen resolution, expand the total/plus and plus/single comparisons. The defining equation of rightDerivedNatTrans gives compatibility of the total and plus units on the bounded-below homotopy category. Apply naturality across the localized augmentation and invert the two units on injective complexes. The homotopy and derived homology factorization isomorphisms cancel. This gives the displayed formula for the chosen resolution.

For any supplied resolution I, choose the standard augmentation-preserving comparison from the chosen injective resolution. Naturality of the total derived unit, the quotient comparison, and homologyFunctorFactors gives a commutative square between the two total calculations. Naturality of isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex gives its classical counterpart. The map on the coefficient is the identity, so compose the squares and cancel the comparison to obtain the formula for I.

lean.statement:
theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.totalClassicalResolutionComparison
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    [EnoughInjectives C] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions C]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (M : C) (I : InjectiveResolution M) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective I.cochainComplex 0
    (F.homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso M n).hom =
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D (n : ℤ)).map
        (F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ C 0).app M).hom ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map I.ι') ≫
          (F.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I.cochainComplex).hom) ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors D (n : ℤ)).app _).hom ≫
        (I.isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex F n).inv
